overview: A professional frontend-only DTC public-transport operations dashboard for automated bus scheduling and route management, powered by clearly-labelled local demo data.
features: Collapsible sidebar navigation with Dashboard, Buses, Crew, Scheduling, Routes, Road Conditions and Reports
Dashboard with KPI cards, bus utilization and crew status charts, today's schedule and operational alerts
Bus management with search, filter, add/edit modal and status badges
Crew management with search, filter, add/edit and crew detail view
Linked Duty scheduling with availability checks and duty preview
Unlinked Duty with duty timelines and validating handover form
